turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Funny. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of a class. Who decided?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You just said my son didn't write his own essay. On what basis, Hale?
Owen. You made an accusation about his essay, so show me what's behind it.
